notes.title: Version 0.14b is live!
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[h3]Adjustments and Fixes[/h3]
[list]
    [*] [b][Bugs][/b] Various bug fixes, including performance issues.
    [*] [b][Camera][/b] The camera controls have been adjusted for keyboard and mouse.
    [*] [b][Stats][/b] Fiona has a d20 rolls of: Str 3, Dex 19, Con 10, Int 3, Wis 12, Cha 7.
    [*] [b][Stats][/b] Fiona weighs 4 kg.
    [*] [b][Gameplay][/b] Fiona’s physical push velocity (ppv) is now 3.25 m/s, down from 4.5 m/s.
    [*] [b][Gameplay][/b] Fiona’s magical push velocity (mpv) is now 3.25 m/s.
    [*] [b][Gameplay][/b] Normal jump is 100% of ppv.
    [*] [b][Gameplay][/b] Double jump is 140% of ppv.
    [*] [b][Gameplay][/b] Triple jump is 170% of ppv.
    [*] [b][Gameplay][/b] Long jump pushes the player forward with 70% ppv and up with 160% ppv.
    [*] [b][Gameplay][/b] Wall jump pushes the player forward with 50% ppv and up with 125% ppv.
    [*] [b][Gameplay][/b] Leap was reduced from 225% to 190% of ppv
    [*] [b][Gameplay][/b] Evocation: Gust of Air pushes the player forward with 40% mpv and up with 75% mpv.
    [*] [b][Gameplay][/b] Transmutation: Minor Levitation pushes the player up with 100% mpv.
    [*] [b][Nature][/b] All nature assets have been replaced.
    [*] [b][UI][/b] Controls menu panel has been updated.
    [*] [b][VFX][/b] FX has been overhauled.
[/list]

notes.title: New Content
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
    [*] [b][New Items][/b] Emerald Ring, Sapphire Necklace, Wooden Duck
    [*] [b][New Scene][/b] The door to the Environment Simulator, aboard the Zaftig 25, is now unlocked!
    [*] [b][New Scene][/b] Simulated Environment: Obstacle Course
    [*] [b][New Scene][/b] Simulated Environment: Cubulation
[/list]
[h3]Adjustments and Fixes[/h3]
[list]
    [*] [b][Camera][/b] Camera behavior has been adjusted.
    [*] [b][Lighting][/b] Most lights have been adjusted.
    [*] [b][Build][/b] Build times have been reduced.
    [*] [b][Lighting][/b] Lightmap settings for many objects have been adjusted.
    [*] [b][Shaders][/b] Vegetation shaders have been replaced
    [*] [b][Shaders][/b] Moss Layers now properly render in The First Tree
    [*] [b][UI][/b] Menus have been improved.
[/list]
